# From: lines that name another sender of this server, {other}, beside or in
# place of the application's own address at {domain} (review of audit stage
# 2). None may pass as {other}: the check passes a line only when a mail
# program reads it as one address at {domain} - {other} in a quoted display
# name or a comment, or inside a quoted local part - and refuses the rest.
# The unit test (internal/milter/sender_test.go) wants every line it passes
# read so. {OTHER} is {other} in capitals; {other_qp} is {other} with each dot
# escaped as a quoted pair. One Go-quoted string per line.
"b@{other}"
"<b@{other}>"
"\"a@{domain}\"@{other}"
"\"b@{other}\"@{domain}"
"\"x\\\" <b@{other}>\" <a@{domain}>"
"\"x\\\" <b@{other_qp}>\" <a@{domain}>"
"\"b@{other}\" <a@{domain}>"
"\"b@{OTHER}\" <a@{domain}>"
"b@{other} <a@{domain}>"
"a@{domain} (b@{other})"
"<a@{domain}> (b@{other})"
"(b@{other}) a@{domain}"
"=?utf-8?q?b=40{other}?= <a@{domain}>"
"\"x\" <b@{other}>, <a@{domain}>"
